'''Uttak''' was an elderly [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who operated [[Uttak's Inn]].

==Personality and traits==
He was paranoid and nosy about the customers of his inn. He would draw his weapons at the slightest provocation.<ref name="H&S" />

==Equipment==
He carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and kept a [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]] in his quarters.<ref name="H&S" />
